spans.name: [media-build 3/3] RUN set -eux;   arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)";   case "$arch" in     amd64) ccache_arch=x86_64;
[precompiler 10/10] RUN   ldconfig;   SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY=1   bundle exec rails assets:precompile;   rm -fr /opt/masto
[ffmpeg 3/5] RUN tar xf n9.0.2.tar.gz && mv FFmpeg-n9.0.2 ffmpeg-9.0.2;
[mastodon 10/11] RUN   bundle exec bootsnap precompile --gemfile app/ lib/ config/;

candidates.summary: The wrapped tool asked for cache keys that were not available in the published cache tag.

harness.timer: restore, build, save; post-job saves in post_job_save_seconds
